records.text: The unidentified UVU eyewitness said the sound resembled a higher caliber such as a nine-millimeter rather than a .45, then qualified that he did not know and that it almost sounded like a cherry bomb; he also called it a gunshot.
records.speaker: UVU eyewitness (identity unverified; episode ZkDO-MRLUco)

appearances.snippet: Calibra it sounded like a higher calibre like a nine millimetre. It didn't sound like a forty five or anything, but I don't know. It didn't sound that deep to me. It almost sounded like a cherry bomb. Um ... It was a gunshot.
